body.name: six-node strict-comparison witness
body.construction: Let \(G_0\) have edges \(1\to2\), \(3\to4\), and \(5\to6\). Let \(V_1,V_3,V_5\) be independent with density \(g(x)\propto\exp\{-1/[x(1-x)]\}\mathbf 1\{0<x<1\}\), let \(Z_2,Z_4,Z_6\) be independent with density \(b(z)\propto\exp\{-1/(1-z^2)\}\mathbf 1\{|z|<1\}\), and set \(V_2=\cos(2\pi V_1)+\sigma Z_2\), \(V_4=V_3+V_3^2+\sigma Z_4\), and \(V_6=V_5+V_5^2+\sigma Z_6\). Use node intervals \([0,1]\), \([-1-\sigma,1+\sigma]\), \([0,1]\), \([-\sigma,2+\sigma]\), \([0,1]\), and \([-\sigma,2+\sigma]\), and denote the induced law by \(P_{\mathrm{sep},\sigma}\).
